# Lovart Supported Models And Options

Use this reference when choosing or validating Lovart CLI model names, aspect ratios, resolutions, durations, and reference input types.

Do not use historical model names. Check `lovart <command> --help` before execution because command help is the live source of truth.

## Image Models

| Model | Use case | Common options |
|---|---|---|
| `GPT Image 2` | Default image model | aspect ratio, resolution, quality, references |
| `Nano Banana 2` | Alternative image model | aspect ratio, resolution, quality, references, or width + height |

### Image sizes

- `21:9`
- `16:9`
- `5:4`
- `4:5`
- `3:2`
- `4:3`
- `1:1`
- `2:3`
- `3:4`
- `9:16`
- `4:1`
- `1:4`
- `8:1`
- `1:8`

### Image resolutions

- `512`
- `1K`
- `2K`
- `4K`

### Image quality

- `low`
- `medium`
- `high`

Notes:

- Default image model: `GPT Image 2`.
- `quality` is mainly meaningful for `GPT Image 2`.
- Default `quality`: `medium`.
- `Nano Banana 2` also supports `width` + `height` instead of `size` + `resolution`.
- When using `width` + `height`, both must be multiples of `16`, and total pixels must not exceed `3840 * 2160`.

## Video Models

| Model | Use case | Common options |
|---|---|---|
| `Seedance Pro 1.5` | Text-to-video or frame-guided video | ratio, resolution/quality, duration, first/last frame references |
| `Seedance 2.0` | Text-to-video, frame-guided, multi-reference, or video edit | ratio, quality, duration, reference mode, image/video/audio references |
| `Seedance 2.0 Fast` | Text-to-video, frame-guided, multi-reference, or video edit | ratio, quality, duration, reference mode, image/video/audio references |
| `Seedance 2.0 Mini` | Text-to-video, frame-guided, multi-reference, or video edit | ratio, quality, duration, reference mode, image/video/audio references |
| `Kling 3.0` | Text-to-video or frame-guided video | ratio, quality, duration, image references |

### Video ratios

- `21:9`
- `16:9`
- `4:3`
- `1:1`
- `3:4`
- `9:16`
- `Auto` (`Seedance 2.0`, `Seedance 2.0 Fast`, and `Seedance 2.0 Mini` only)

### Video resolutions

- `480p`
- `720p`
- `1080p`

### Video duration ranges

- `Seedance Pro 1.5`: `4-12`
- `Seedance 2.0`: `4-15`
- `Seedance 2.0 Fast`: `4-15`
- `Seedance 2.0 Mini`: `4-15`
- `Kling 3.0`: `4-15`

Notes:

- `reference_mode: startEnd` is the standard frame-guided video mode.
- `reference_mode: multiImage` and `reference_mode: videoEdit` are for `Seedance 2.0`, `Seedance 2.0 Fast`, and `Seedance 2.0 Mini`.
- Do not invent extra mode flags for `Kling 3.0`; choose the model and let the CLI handle the request shape.

## Reference Fields

### Image generation

- `reference_image_urls`: array of public image URLs

### Video generation

- `reference_image_urls`: public image URL or managed `local-asset://...` array
- `reference_video_urls`: public video URL or managed `local-asset://...` array
- `reference_audio_urls`: public audio URL or managed `local-asset://...` array

When using the CLI, local file paths can be passed directly where command help allows them. Do not use legacy names like `referenceImage`, `firstFrame`, or `lastFrame`.

## Moderated Asset Upload

Use the separate `asset_upload` CLI command when a reference must go through the Lovart asset moderation flow first.

Common CLI concepts:

- `asset_type`
- `source`
- `content_type`
- `display_name`

Result fields to expect:

- `asset_id`
- `asset_uri`
- `asset_url`
- `moderation_status`
- `replicas`

Use `asset_list` for managed assets and `asset_status --asset-id <id>` for one
asset. Kit ids, moderation channels, account ids, and upstream `asset://...`
values are internal service details.
